01The studio

Good design is felt, not explained.

Skymoon Studios treats software not just as working code, but as an experience people genuinely want to return to every day.

We combine engineering discipline with a designer's eye. From mobile apps to web platforms, from interface design to backend architecture, we build every layer of a product with the same level of care.

  1. 01

    Focused, fast delivery

    Short sprints, clear milestones and transparent progress at every stage.

  2. 02

    Design-led engineering

    Scalable products where aesthetics and performance are never a trade-off.

  3. 03

    Long-term partnership

    We stay with you after launch: maintenance, analytics and continuous improvement.

03Selected work

Selected work

Products we took from first idea to launch — now in the hands of real users.

skymoongpa.site
01Web application2026

Skymoon GPA

A GPA calculator and what-if planner for Koç University students. It instantly answers “what will my GPA be if I get these grades this term?” — just paste your transcript.

  • Transcript import, grade simulation and target-GPA planning
  • Serverless by design: data never leaves the device
  • Offline-ready PWA with TR/EN and dark mode
  • React 19
  • TypeScript
  • Vite
  • Tailwind CSS
  • PWA
Visit the site
02Mobile app2026

StyleUpS

An AI-powered personal styling assistant. Users digitise their wardrobe, get outfit suggestions tuned to mood and colour, and share their looks with the community.

  • Garment recognition and AI outfit recommendations
  • Tiered membership model with in-app subscriptions
  • Server-side content moderation and app attestation
  • React Native
  • Expo
  • Firebase
  • OpenAI API
styleups.me
03Web platform2026

StyleUpS website

The marketing site for the StyleUpS brand. It tells the product story through fluid motion and brings together the legal and support pages required for app store review.

  • Smooth, performant animations with Framer Motion
  • Bilingual Turkish / English architecture
  • Privacy, terms, support and account deletion pages
  • Next.js 15
  • React 19
  • TypeScript
  • Framer Motion
Visit the site
eggbistro.com.tr
04Client work · Restaurant2026

Egg Bistro

A bilingual website for a stone-oven bistro and cocktail bar in Zekeriyaköy, Istanbul. It conveys the venue's warm atmosphere through large photography and gets guests to the menu, directions and a one-tap reservation call in seconds.

  • Turkish / English pages generated from a single source, with zero runtime dependencies
  • Local SEO: Restaurant schema, hreflang, sitemap and link previews
  • Responsive WebP imagery, self-hosted fonts (GDPR/KVKK) and strict security headers
  • HTML
  • CSS
  • JavaScript
  • Node.js
  • Vercel
